title: Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning for Dense Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.14107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning-intensive retrieval requires text representations to capture not only semantic similarity, but also the reasoning needed to determine relevance under a given retrieval instruction. Existing reasoning-enhanced embedding models improve retrieval by incorporating reasoning information into dense representations, yet their supervision is typically dominated by the final retrieval objective. As a result, latent reasoning trajectories may learn shortcut reasoning patterns that preserve retrieval performance without producing meaningful incremental retrieval gains. We propose Retrieval Grounding Latent Reasoning (RGLT), a latent reasoning framework for dense retrieval that explicitly connects intermediate latent transitions with retrieval improvements. translated_title: 面向稠密检索的检索接地潜在推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14107v1 公告类型：新 摘要：推理密集型检索要求文本表示不仅捕捉语义相似性，还要捕捉在给定检索指令下确定相关性所需的推理能力。现有的推理增强嵌入模型通过将推理信息纳入稠密表示来提升检索性能，但其监督信号通常由最终检索目标主导。因此，潜在推理轨迹可能学习到捷径推理模式，这些模式保持检索性能而不产生有意义的增量检索增益。我们提出了检索接地潜在推理（RGLT），一种用于稠密检索的潜在推理框架，它显式地将中间潜在转换与检索改进联系起来。RGLT通过由静默标记构建的指令条件潜在推理轨迹，在隐藏空间中进行非自回归推理。它结合了过程监督，确保推理步骤与检索目标对齐。
tldr: RGLT框架通过显式连接潜在推理轨迹与检索改进，并采用过程监督，避免了捷径推理，从而在稠密检索中实现更有效的推理增强。
en_tdlr: The RGLT framework explicitly links latent reasoning trajectories to retrieval improvements with process supervision, avoiding shortcut reasoning for more effective reasoning-enhanced dense retrieval.
